commands: jq -r 'if .Results then (["| Package | Severity | Installed | Fixed In | CVE |", "|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|"] + [.Results[] | .Vulnerabilities[]? | "| \(.PkgName) | \(.Severity) | \(.InstalledVersion) | \(.FixedVersion) | \(.VulnerabilityID) |"]) | join("\n") else "No High/Critical vulnerabilities found." end' /tmp/report.json
& C:\trivy\trivy.exe fs C:\ --scanners vuln --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --ignore-unfixed --format json > C:\report.json 2>$null

if ($null -eq $report.Results) { Write-Output 'No High/Critical vulnerabilities found.' } else { Write-Output '| Package | Severity | Installed | Fixed In | CVE |'; Write-Output '|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|'; foreach ($result in $report.Results) { foreach ($vuln in $result.Vulnerabilities) { Write-Output "| $($vuln.PkgName) | $($vuln.Severity) | $($vuln.InstalledVersion) | $($vuln.FixedVersion) | $($vuln.VulnerabilityID) |" } } }
